arguments.rationale: The `DrinkPricer` currently suffers from primitive obsession, handling the pricing logic for sizes, milk types, and shots all in one place. By extracting these concepts into their own value objects (`Size`, `Milk`, and `Shots`), we move the behavior to the objects that hold the data (Tell, Don't Ask). This gives each class a single reason to change, making the design more modular and easier to extend.

<?php

use Brew\Size;

describe(Size::class, function () {
    it('has a base price for small', function () {
        expect((new Size('small'))->basePrice())->toBe(250);
    });

    it('has a base price for medium', function () {
        expect((new Size('medium'))->basePrice())->toBe(300);
    });

    it('has a base price for large', function () {
        expect((new Size('large'))->basePrice())->toBe(350);
    });

    it('refuses an unknown size', function () {
        expect(fn () => new Size('huge'))->toThrow(new InvalidArgumentException('Unknown size "huge".'));
    });
});

<?php

namespace Brew;

final class DrinkPricer
{
    public function priceOf(string $size, string $milk, int $shots): Money
    {
        $pence = (new Size($size))->basePrice();

        if ($milk === 'oat') {
            $pence += 40;
        } elseif ($milk === 'almond') {
            $pence += 50;
        } elseif ($milk === 'soy') {
            $pence += 30;
        }

        if ($shots > 1) {
            $pence += ($shots - 1) * 60;
        }

        return new Money($pence);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Brew;

use InvalidArgumentException;

final class Size
{
    private int $basePrice;

    public function __construct(string $size)
    {
        $this->basePrice = match ($size) {
            'small' => 250,
            'medium' => 300,
            'large' => 350,
            default => throw new InvalidArgumentException(sprintf('Unknown size "%s".', $size)),
        };
    }

    public function basePrice(): int
    {
        return $this->basePrice;
    }
}

    });

    it('has a surcharge for almond', function () {
        expect((new Milk('almond'))->surcharge())->toBe(50);
    });

    it('has a surcharge for soy', function () {
        expect((new Milk('soy'))->surcharge())->toBe(30);

<?php

namespace Brew;

final class DrinkPricer
{
    public function priceOf(string $size, string $milk, int $shots): Money
    {
        $pence = (new Size($size))->basePrice();
        $pence += (new Milk($milk))->surcharge();

        if ($shots > 1) {
            $pence += ($shots - 1) * 60;
        }

        return new Money($pence);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Brew;

final class Milk
{
    private int $surcharge;

    public function __construct(string $milk)
    {
        $this->surcharge = match ($milk) {
            'oat' => 40,
            'almond' => 50,
            'soy' => 30,
            default => 0,
        };
    }

    public function surcharge(): int
    {
        return $this->surcharge;
    }
}

<?php

use Brew\Shots;

describe(Shots::class, function () {
    it('has no surcharge for a single shot', function () {
        expect((new Shots(1))->surcharge())->toBe(0);
    });

    it('has a surcharge for every shot after the first', function () {
        expect((new Shots(3))->surcharge())->toBe(120);
    });
});

<?php

namespace Brew;

final class DrinkPricer
{
    public function priceOf(string $size, string $milk, int $shots): Money
    {
        $pence = (new Size($size))->basePrice();
        $pence += (new Milk($milk))->surcharge();
        $pence += (new Shots($shots))->surcharge();

        return new Money($pence);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Brew;

final class Shots
{
    private int $surcharge;

    public function __construct(int $count)
    {
        $this->surcharge = $count > 1 ? ($count - 1) * 60 : 0;
    }

    public function surcharge(): int
    {
        return $this->surcharge;
    }
}
